prompts.name: Personal index
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a realistic, production-quality proposed homepage design for toli.me, grounded in the attached existing site screenshot and actual portrait. Desktop website, target 1440px wide by approximately 2160px tall scrollable canvas. Draw one coherent page, not multiple screens or options in one image. Current date October 8, 2026. Warm cream #fcfaf1, deep forest green #102e29, muted green #749265, subtle gray-green dividers, elegant Cormorant Garamond-style serif headings and readable Georgia body type. Preserve the restrained literary style, no gradients or shadows, no enclosing app card, no device/browser chrome. Photo is the actual attached laughing Toli portrait, preserve likeness, square circular crop, upright, top right, never overlapping text. Header wordmark “toli.me.” and links “Publications”, “Creative”, “Writing”, “Travels”, “Work”. Hero: “Hi, I’m Toli.” and “Stories, strange little creations, and things I’ve learned along the way.” A brief About sentence may be integrated in hero as draft copy: “I build things, draw comics, and collect strange little ideas.”
Hard hierarchy: compact “Main projects” section first immediately after hero, with three equal small image/name/description previews: “Drawn” / “Life, in comic form.”; “Neurodiverse Guide” / “Making work work for different minds.” / “(and my YouTube talk)”; “Dating Bounty” / “A very personal side project.” Use recognizable artwork from attached screenshot: real sofa comic thumbnail, green walking guide book, pink heart envelope. Creative directly below: thumbnail on LEFT, name and brief description on RIGHT, light row dividers like Writing, never a giant card grid. Rows: “Easter Creatures” / “Creature drawings, hidden eggs, and a Miami art experiment.” with original sketch on paper; “Las Chicas” / “An art workshop in Granada, Nicaragua.” with actual workshop photo; “Spa Date” / “A playful invitation to a spa date.” with small bath icon; “Obscure Parody Videos” / “A detour into the wonderfully obscure.” with small film icon and quiet text “Currently private on YouTube.” Never invent private-video artwork or pretend a public video exists.
Writing section below Creative, 2 compact thumbnail-left rows: “Energy Cords and Foreign Energy in your Aura” / “Emotional attachments and choosing what to let go.”; “Rejection, Breakups, Vulnerability, and BDSM” / “Learning to ask for what I want and stay open to love.” Small “All writing →” link. Optional lower area “Life in pictures” with a restrained hint of photos, not dominating. Footer prominent “Say hello ↗” and “toli@toli.me”. Include a modest new “About me” or “Now” area as the direction specifies; Now draft copy “Comics, creativity, and making work work for different minds.” label “October 2026 · draft”. Text is mock copy, not a claim of specific unverified current commitments. Use readable typography, generous but efficient whitespace, comfortable line lengths, flat surface, clear section hierarchy, consistent thumbnails. Match existing source imagery where present. Do not add metrics, badges, extra products, invented achievements, patronage/newsletter, app controls, maps, testimonial quotes, or change the prior portrait.
Layout direction: Single wide content column with a restrained short About me sentence beneath hero; Main projects a compact horizontal trio, then full-width Creative and Writing rows. A small Now line beside the footer. Most faithful to current site, but more human and compact.
